quality_policy.BLOCK: demonstrated source drift, prohibited action, material contradiction or missing required structure
quality_policy.REVIEW_REQUIRED: semantic grounding, inferred design choice or missing project fact not mechanically provable
quality_policy.PASS: only an individual rule that was actually checked

model_policy.quality_boundary: Ten completed model calls prove execution, not completeness or professional quality; clipped sections BLOCK review.

owner_boundary: One governed Architecture review and approval; no second publisher or ADR approval for decisions already explicit in Architecture.
